testcase.name: Scenario: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-quick-access-source/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:140:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled ✔ When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is disabled ✔ When the user dismisses the menu and remove the Extrude quick access icon ✔ And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again ✔ Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled
